##### Project general facts

Grosvenor House is a boutique residential building by Lotus Living, a British developer bringing its experience of the London residential market to Dubai. The project combines British-inspired design with modern functionality, focusing on attention to detail, efficient layouts and long-term value. The contemporary facade pairs light stone-toned frames with warm timber-style louvres and glazed balconies, while a crowned rooftop completes the silhouette. The residences are offered as one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each with a private balcony and a separate laundry room, designed for refined everyday living in a private, community-focused setting.

Shared facilities are concentrated on the rooftop and the ground floor. The rooftop hosts an outdoor swimming pool framed by sun loungers and shaded seating, a landscaped outdoor lounge with daybeds for relaxing in the open air, and an indoor gym equipped with cardio and strength training stations. On the ground floor, a dedicated kids' lounge gives younger residents a safe space to play, making the building suitable for families as well as couples and professionals. A welcoming reception lobby with marble-effect finishes sets the tone at the entrance.

Interiors follow a calm, neutral palette with herringbone wood-effect flooring, classic wall panelling and generous glazing that opens living areas and bedrooms onto the balconies. Living and kitchen areas benefit from high ceilings, creating a sense of space and light. Kitchens feature marble-effect worktops and backsplashes, an island or breakfast counter and built-in appliances, while bathrooms are finished in light stone tones with walk-in showers. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, leaving owners free to style the space to their own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a master-planned district in the southern part of Dubai, built around Al Maktoum International Airport and positioned as one of the city's major growth corridors. The area sits close to Expo City Dubai and Jebel Ali Port, two of the emirate's key economic and logistics hubs. Its residential neighbourhoods are planned with wide landscaped streets, green spaces and community facilities, offering a calmer pace of life away from the dense city centre while keeping business destinations within easy reach.

Connectivity is a key advantage of Dubai South. Direct access to Emirates Road and Expo Road links the district with Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, providing straightforward drives to Dubai Marina, Jebel Ali and Downtown Dubai. Expo City Dubai adds exhibition, event and leisure venues to the neighbourhood, while the nearby Dubai Investments Park and Jebel Ali Industrial City add further employment hubs within a short drive.

From an investment perspective, Dubai South attracts residents and tenants among professionals working at the airport, in aviation, logistics and the surrounding business parks. The district is a freehold area, open to ownership by international buyers. Its continued infrastructure development and its role as a gateway to Al Maktoum International Airport position it as an attractive choice for both end-users seeking a quieter residential setting and investors targeting long-term rental demand.
